test_name: Physical and Environmental Protection - PE-6 Secondary Control Gap
architecture:
System: Citizen-Services-108
Primary NIST family: Physical and Environmental Protection (PE); evidence focus: PE-6.
Environment: Azure. Network access uses Private Link; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Key Vault key. Control evidence: camera review coverage has a documented fifteen-minute maintenance gap with compensating guard coverage. The gap is documented as a secondary control deficiency; there is no plaintext transport, no public database exposure, no unencrypted administrator credential in S3, and privileged MFA remains enabled.
